About.title: About Us
About.description: As Azmed Engineering Electronics, we have been adding value to healthcare professionals for over 20 years by combining quality and innovation in the medical device sector.
About.subtitle: Trust and Technology in Health
About.visionText: As a pioneer in healthcare technologies in Turkey and neighboring regions, to build a future where every healthcare institution can access the most modern devices. We combine global standards with local experience.
About.missionText: To contribute directly to public health by offering high-quality medical devices with expert technical support and an honest trade approach. We continue to be the trusted companion of healthcare professionals.
About.journeyText: Milestones of our success story of more than 20 years.
About.valuesText: Our values that make Azmed Engineering who we are and enable us to work for the better every day.
About.value1Desc: Transparency and ethical values are our core principles in all business processes.
About.value2Desc: We closely follow the latest developments in healthcare technologies.
About.value3Desc: Human health is always at the center of our solutions.
About.value4Desc: We build trust with continuous support before and after sales.
About.m1Desc: We started medical device sales based in Istanbul.

About.m3Desc: We incorporated the latest AI-supported imaging systems into our portfolio.
